messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your Apple ID was used to purchase "Run Forrest Run" from the iTunes Store on a Personal Computer or another device that had not previously been connected with your Apple ID.', 'You have 1 unread message(s)...', 'For security reasons, we have temporarily suspended your account and your access to online banking will be restricted if you fail to re-confirm your membership details.', "We've recently noticed that someone has made 3 suspicious attempts to login into your online account from this address 66.221.4.04", 'We recently reviewed your account, and suspect that your Internet Banking Account is being accessed from an unauthorized computer.', 'Your account has been limited until we hear from you', 'You have been sent an INTERACT Email Money Transfer.', 'For the protection of your account we have suspended access to it.', 'WE HAVE CONCLUDED THAT YOU ARE ELIGIBLE TO RECEIVE A TAX REFUND OF 1,500.89 GBP.', 'Thanks for your order. We’ll let you know once your item(s) have dispatched.', 'I have registered the ATM MASTER CARD with FedEx COMPANY this morning as we agreed, and the delivery will take off tomorrow morning based on my agreement with FedEx Director:REV.JAMES LONG', 'IMPORTANT - Account Scheduled For Termination', 'Your order #74-4211325 accepted.', 'This member has a question for you.', "As a result, we've reversed this transaction.", 'your first payment $5,000.00 sent to your name today', 'Our records indicate that your Capital One 360 Username and Password are now inactive.', 'Your checking account billing information has been deleted during our recent upgrade and maintenances of our database against Virus.', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by JPMorgan CHASE to inform you that we were unable to verify your account details.', 'Barclays Bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Barclays Security software.', 'The security update will be effective immediately and requires our customers to update their access.', "We've updated the changes you made to your profile."]

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
